data.title: Pittsburgh Animal Rescue Thrift Shop
data.subtitle: Whether you're looking for a one-of-a-kind collectible, gently-used clothing, housewares, or pet products, support animal rescue in Pittsburgh by shopping at our resale boutique resale boutique. 100% of sales benefit the rescue and care of animals in need.

data.title: Shop Hours
paragraphs: Note: These hours are for the Thrift Shop only. All animal meet-and-greets are by appointment. Check Facebook or join our mailing list for sale dates and hours updates.

data.title: Donate Items to Our Thrift Shop
✓ Accepted Donations
items: gently-used clothing (women’s clothing only, no pants)

data.title: ✗ Not Accepted
items: oversized items such as large appliances or furniture
books/magazines, DVDs, CDs and cassette tapes
items that are broken, stained, torn or missing parts

data.title: Important Donation Information
items: All larger donations require an appointment. Call 412-928-9777 during open hours.
Drop-off during Thrift Shop hours at 35 Wabash Street, Pittsburgh, PA 15220.

Since its founding in 1984, Animal Advocates has remained committed to a no-kill policy and advocacy on behalf of animals. In accordance with this philosophy and our mission statement, please be advised that we do not accept donations of merchandise made from animal products, such as fur, leather, down or silk.
